# Vendored Three.js

`three.cjs` is the unmodified CommonJS build from Three.js **0.180.0 (r180)**. It is bundled into the standalone HTML by `scripts/build.mjs`. No browser CDN requests are needed.

- Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180
- License: [MIT](three-LICENSE.txt), included verbatim in the built HTML.
- SHA-256: `2980c5831824f46d79a39a93feb70dd851538ce5b5480a6463883b319022c51f`

Keep the build and its license together when updating. Run the preset tests, build checks, and visual checks after a Three.js upgrade.
